methodologyNotes: Products selected as notable smart speakers a buyer compares in 2026, covering entry-level, mid-range, and premium tiers from Amazon, Google, Apple, Sonos, and Bose. Primary sources: Apple Support spec pages (support.apple.com), Sonos product pages (sonos.com), SoundGuys reviews (soundguys.com), Digital Trends reviews (digitaltrends.com), Tom's Guide (tomsguide.com), and web-search-corroborated manufacturer data. For Amazon products, manufacturer product pages render JavaScript-only content; specs were sourced from SoundGuys reviews, Digital Trends, and web search aggregations citing Amazon's official spec sheets. priceUsd is US MSRP at launch for the base/reference config; current street prices may differ. Bose Home Speaker 500 MSRP: original launch $399.95 (2018), Bose repriced to $379 and it remains available at major retailers as of June 2026. Sonos Era 300 original MSRP $449 (March 2023); Sonos reduced to $379 as of June 2026 — launch MSRP used. Echo Studio (2nd gen, 2025) released October 2025 at $219.99. All accessedAt values are 2026-06-15.

products.name: Amazon Echo (4th Gen)
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch (October 22, 2020) per Amazon and multiple reviews. Frequently discounted; as of June 2026 regular street price ~$64–$99.
products.provenance: Dimensions (5.7 x 5.7 x 5.2 in / 144 x 144 x 133 mm), weight 986 g, drivers (76mm woofer + 2x 20mm tweeters), Bluetooth 5.0, Zigbee hub, Amazon Sidewalk, 3.5mm jack confirmed from SoundGuys review. WiFi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac dual-band and $99 MSRP confirmed from Digital Trends review and web search citing Amazon spec sheet. Release date October 22, 2020. Dolby Audio processing confirmed. No automatic room calibration — audio_calibration=false.

products.name: Amazon Echo Dot (5th Gen)
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch (October 20, 2022) per Amazon and retailer listings.

specs.smart_home_hub: Amazon Sidewalk, eero Wi-Fi extender built-in

products.provenance: Dimensions (3.9 x 3.9 x 3.5 in) and weight (10.7 oz / ~303 g) confirmed from Staples product listing and web search aggregating Amazon's spec sheet. 1.73-inch (44mm) driver confirmed from Staples and Tom's Guide data. WiFi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac dual-band confirmed. eero built-in (extends compatible eero network, up to 1,000 sq ft / 100 Mbps). Temperature sensor included. No 3.5mm jack (removed vs 4th gen). Release October 20, 2022. $49.99 US launch MSRP confirmed from TechRadar and multiple retailer listings.

products.name: Amazon Echo Studio (2nd Gen)
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch (October 29, 2025) per Amazon and SoundGuys review.

specs.drivers: 1x 3.75-inch high-excursion woofer, 3x 2.25-inch full-range drivers (left, right, upward-firing)
specs.smart_home_hub: Zigbee, Matter, Thread Border Router, eero

No 3.5mm/optical input (removed vs 1st gen). Automatic room calibration via microphone array = audio_calibration true.

products.name: Google Nest Audio
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch (September 30, 2020) per Google Store.
products.provenance: Dimensions (6.89 x 4.89 x 3.07 in / 175 x 124 x 78 mm), weight 2.65 lbs (1.2 kg), 75mm mid-woofer + 19mm tweeter, WiFi 802.11b/g/n/ac dual-band, Bluetooth 5.0, Chromecast built-in, 3 far-field microphones confirmed from Google Store spec page (URL confirmed via web search returning 'store.google.com/product/nest_audio_specs') and Digital Trends review. $99.99 US price confirmed from Google Store listing and Wikipedia. Media EQ and Ambient IQ adaptive volume = audio_calibration true. No Zigbee hub. No aux/line out. Release September 30, 2020.

products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch (February 3, 2023) per Apple Store. $299 confirmed as current price as of June 2026.

specs.drivers: 1x 4-inch high-excursion woofer, 5x horn-loaded tweeters (each with neodymium magnet)
specs.smart_home_hub: HomeKit hub, Matter, Thread Border Router

products.name: Sonos Era 100

products.name: Sonos Move 2
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch (September 20, 2023) per Sonos.com. Still listed at $449 as of June 2026.
products.provenance: Dimensions (241 x 160 x 127 mm = 9.49 x 6.30 x 5.00 in), weight 3 kg (6.61 lbs), dual tweeters for stereo + midwoofer, 3 class-D amplifiers, WiFi 6, Bluetooth 5.0, IP56 water/dust resistance, 24-hour battery life, USB-C charging, Trueplay automatic tuning, AirPlay 2, Amazon Alexa + Sonos Voice Control confirmed from SoundGuys and TechRadar. $449 US launch MSRP confirmed. products.name: Bose Home Speaker 500
products.priceNote: Original US MSRP at launch was $399.95 (September 20, 2018). Bose reduced to $379 MSRP; current retail price $379 per Best Buy and Walmart as of June 2026.
products.provenance: Dimensions (203 x 170 x 109 mm = 8.0 x 6.7 x 4.3 in), weight 2,150 g (4.74 lbs), two opposing 2.5-inch full-range drivers, WiFi, Bluetooth 4.2 (SBC + AAC), 3.5mm aux line-in, AirPlay 2, Chromecast built-in, 8-microphone array, Amazon Alexa + Google Assistant (user-selectable), Bose Music app multiroom, $379 current MSRP confirmed from SoundGuys review and RTINGS.com. Release September 20, 2018. No dedicated smart home hub / Zigbee. No room calibration. Anodized aluminum body, front-facing color LCD display for song info. Still sold new at Best Buy and Walmart as of June 2026 with active firmware support.
